messages:
alexa: Heads-up — I ran into a nasty combo in the starter sample: JSON mode + strict function-schema causes the Node SDK to enter an auth-retry loop when a downstream tool returns 401. Blocks onboarding. Repro steps and logs below.

matt: oh no. can you paste the repro?

alexa: repro (quick):
1) start sample app with JSON mode enabled
2) trigger a function call that proxies to our internal tool which responds 401 for expired token
3) SDK keeps retrying auth (backoff) instead of surfacing auth error

Example request body we send:```json
{
  "model": "gpt-xyz",
  "mode": "json",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"call-check"}],
  "function_call": {"name":"check_status","arguments_schema": {"type":"object","properties": {"id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["id"]}}
}```
Logs:```
[2026-03-21T14:22:10Z] ERR auth: tool returned 401
[2026-03-21T14:22:10Z] INFO retrying auth attempt=1
[2026-03-21T14:22:12Z] INFO retrying auth attempt=2
...
[2026-03-21T14:22:45Z] INFO retrying auth attempt=6
```

jordan: probably the parity change we merged last week that aligned client behavior with runtime retries. Node SDK started treating 401 from tool call as transient by default. That was intended for token-refresh flows, but when the downstream tool is a third-party it should surface 401.

matt: agreed — we should not auto-retry on AUTH failures unless we can verify it's a token-refresh path. two options: a) don't retry on 401 at all, b) make it opt-in via config flag like `retryOnAuthErrors`.

alexa: for the starter kit customer the quick mitigation is to set an env var. I hacked a local patch: `process.env.REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_AUTH = 'false'` and the app stops the loop and surfaces the 401 to the app.

priya: customer reported onboarding blocked; they hit this on their first run and thought Redwood's API was flaky. Can we get a quick patch?

sam-bot: CI: test-suite/samples failed on `sampleflow-jsonmode` (see https://ci/c/12345) :red_circle:

matt: I'll open a small patch PR to Node SDK to default to NOT retrying on 401 from tool/function call unless `retryOnAuthErrors` is true. I'll also add an integration test in the sample app. Assigning to @matt, tagging @jordan for runtime behavior review.

alexa: please also add a short note in starter-kit/README about JSON mode + strict schemas and the auth-retry caveat so we don't hit more support tickets.

matt: PR opened: https://repo/rw/node-sdk/pull/789 (patch + test). plan: cut 0.12.3 patch release after green CI.

priya: thanks — I'll email the customer workaround (env var) and ETA.

jordan: once patch is out I'll coordinate a runtime-side guard too (make sure we surface auth failures to client when appropriate).

alexa: awesome — thanks everyone. please add a small reproducer gist to the PR so support can reproduce locally. :thumbsup:
